description: The world's edge and shore, local metres. edges: the outline of the built tiles (built tiles on the left of travel, +x east, +z south); kind land = the world stops on dry ground (wall it: there is no ground beyond), kind water = the outline crosses open water. shore: the land/water line inside the built tiles (10 m ground lattice water flags, marching squares, simplified 2.5 m; land on the left of travel): the sea-wall line and the Bay-edge refill zone. Sea level y = 0.
attribution: Derived from USGS 3DEP elevation (public domain) and the built tile set.
